items.html: *With this you will understand the secret of the Nesira, which gives her the Dinim, which are the Achoraim. For at first, he had the externality called Achor, which is the smallness. And understand this — the intermediate is not called Achoraim, and he had Achor and intermediate. And when the face comes, which is the greatness, then what was Malchut, in the secret of Ibur alone, a single vessel in the back (he grew her from his back into a complete Partzuf, up to opposite the chest, which is half his measure; and behold, she is completed like him, although she is half his measure, and she is still lacking Yesod and Malchut — and this is because she is not yet complete like him, but only half of him, like the time of his suckling; and the third inner vessel is lacking from her), for at the time that he has Ibur, she has no measure at all, only the Atara of the Yesod, which is half the measure within her; and now she grew (like his Yesod) like him.
